## Research notes (private)

### Research checked October 16, 2026

**Identity checked:** Frederik van Rossum, Pathetic Story, op.61, concerto for alto saxophone and orchestra, with piano reduction.

**Findings**

- WorldCat documents Millstone, Ramillies,©2002 edition for alto saxophone, string orchestra, harp, piano and percussion.
- Competition primary indexed reports identify it as 2002 Dinant final commissioned compulsory concerto; a forum's 2006 claim is contradicted by competition records.
- Orchestral catalogue at Gulabin lists 2000–2001 composition and 24 minutes; primary composition-date confirmation still needed.
- Elkin distributor catalogue identifies alto+piano reduction MP0261; used-score dealer describes 54-page score plus 18-page solo part, Millstone 2002.
- ARTS² library catalogue confirms Hiroshi Hara recording on International Adolphe Sax Association 2013 three-CD/DVDcollection.
- Existing Cebedem publisher is preserved as a conflicting lead; located edition says Millstone.

**Notation inspected:** No.

**Recordings and listening leads**

- [Hiroshi Hara, Pathetic Story, International Adolphe Sax Association 2013 anthology CD1](https://pmb.artsaucarre.be/opac_css/index.php?id=2553&lvl=publisher_see) Library exact composer, title, performer and disc contents verified live; no accessible stream or audition.

**Collection fit:** Professional international competition final concerto,2002 Dinant. Strong college/professional relevance.

**Catalog observations and proposed corrections**

These refer to the catalog at the start of research. Verified missing fields were filled. Changes to existing values remain proposals.

- Instruments: Alto saxophone Piano reduction (catalog at research start: Any Saxophone Piano). Library, competition, and distributor identify alto specifically.
- Publisher: Review Millstone©2002 edition MP0261 (catalog at research start: Cebedem). Located library edition differs from current metadata.

**Still unknown**

- No public notation inspected or streaming URL verified.
- Composition 2000–2001 needs primary corroboration; 2002 is verified edition/competition year.
- Existing Cebedem publisher conflicts with located Millstone edition.
- AIAS report PDF URLs redirect to unrelated current website document and were not treated as opened evidence.

**Sources and access**

- [WorldCat](https://search.worldcat.org/title/Pathetic-story-%3A-concerto-for-alto-saxophone-in-E-string-orchestra-harp-piano-and-percussion-opus-61/oclc/62139910): Millstone 2002, op 61, and full orchestral scoring. Search-index evidence only; source page not retrieved.
